source: I want to create a game where its a story game and its where us as the player is lost in a forest and we have this guide called mat. mat helps us find recources to build a campfire and make a shelter, but then it starts storming. mat tells us to stay in the shelter while he gets food. when hes gone we wonder why mat was in the forest in the first place. its gotten late, and mat isnt back yet. we get tired and fall asleep. we end up waking up in the middle of the night becasue we got a bad feeling, and then noticed mat standing in the corner with a creepy smile on his face. when we ask why hes standing there, he says run. theres a chase scene where we have to follow the arrows around the forest until we reach city. we start screaming for help from the hundreds of people walking around, but no one answers. mat appears out of no where and tells us its too late. we're already dead

image_prompt.text: A threshold between story beats - the clearing, the shelter at night, the chase route, the city
The forest path breaking out of dense trees onto the distant city skyline
Drop-downs and thickets along the chase that stop the player doubling back into finished forest
A winding forest route marked by arrows for the player to follow during the chase
a campfire built in a forest clearing
a makeshift shelter of branches and leaves beside the fire
arrows marking the way through the trees during the chase
a city street crowded with hundreds of people walking past who never answer

layout_placement.text: Wood, branches and stones gathered from the forest floor to build the campfire and the shelter
Where Mat appears - standing in the corner of the shelter at night, then again in the city

notes: The chase section wants zero dead ends in its forest topology, which is Survival's looping warren and would route P6; the dominant genre owns the shape, so it is recorded here instead.
The map changes state across the story - clear day, storm, night, city - and there is no way to express that ordering.
Survival was loaded as a secondary genre only for the pursuing NPC origin.

open_questions.ask: How much forest - one clearing and a chase route, or a wood you can get lost in?
Is the city a separate map from the forest, or reached by running to it?

coverage_missing.ask: Does the player ever escape, or is the scripted ending always the same?
How big is the city - one street, or a whole downtown?
Are the story beats separate maps, or one forest that changes over time?

answers.ask: How much forest - one clearing and a chase route, or a wood you can get lost in?
answers.answer: Use one main clearing for gathering, building the campfire and shelter, plus a clearly marked chase route through the forest. Keep it focused rather than making a large forest players can freely get lost in.

answers.ask: Is the city a separate map from the forest, or reached by running to it?
answers.answer: The city should be reached by running to it at the end of the forest chase, as a continuous transition rather than a separate map.
